note: PART cases of meiji-resolutions.json transcribed for the v2 assembler (hist-coverage-depth pilot). One entry per 1920 町村 that a resolution marks whole_or_part=part. `locate` = the pre-1889 villages (藩政村) whose land is to be found as 大字 in e-Stat 小地域 2020 and clipped to the 1920 町村; the rest of the 町村 is the other side. `unlocatable` = a village the research itself says cannot be separated by 大字 (one village divided within itself, or a same-named pair) — such a case stays withheld whenever the two sides differ. `sideHint` picks, in a split interval, the assignment whose part_detail describes the located villages (scored: mentions the hint, says only/のみ, does not say all but/except/除く). Every list below is copied from the part_detail / villages_pre1889 text quoted in `from`; nothing is added that the research does not state.
